saved_experiment.name: G11 E512 TOPK10 warp-per-token routing_topk_softmax_type1_pack fast path
saved_experiment.reason_not_kept: Correctness passed, but end-to-end latency regressed versus the committed best checkpoint.
notes: The warp fast path launched one warp per token, with 8 warps per block, and used shared memory to merge each lane's local top-10 over 16 experts.
The first draft had a potential last-block deadlock because invalid warps returned before __syncthreads(); the tested draft fixed that with a valid guard.
The measured regression indicates routing_topk is not the next highest-leverage path in this form.

staged_for_checkpoint: the two routing_warp_checkpoint profile JSON files

next_recommended_steps: Do not re-enable the warp-per-token routing fast path unless it is redesigned and benchmarked in isolation.
Focus next on routing metadata construction, hidden pack, or larger epilogue/GEMM fusion opportunities; current GEMM1, SwiGLU requant, GEMM2, and final scatter remain the dominant measured stages.
Preserve flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe as both correctness oracle and performance baseline.
